CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY ------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Pankaj Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Someshwar Roy, Addl. P.P.
------
Order No.03 Dated- 18.09.2023 Heard the parties.

Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with PCR Case No.232 of 2022 registered under sections 406/420 of the Indian Penal Code.

The Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner being the power of attorney holder of the complainant, sold the land of the complainant and has received Rs.56,27,000/- but did not pay the said amount to the complainant.
It is further submitted that the allegations against the petitioner are all false and the co-accused has already paid Rs.4,40,000/- to the complainant and agreed to pay the rest of the amount.
It is then submitted that on the basis of compromise, the complainant has executed General Power of Attorney in the name of the petitioner and the co-accused -Kishore Saw.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Learned Addl. P.P. on the other hand vehemently opposes the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail and submits that the undisputed fact remains that the petitioner sold the property belonging to the informant in exercise of the power vested upon him by the power of attorney executed by the complainant and has received an amount of Rs.56,27,000/-but has not paid the same to the complainant without any plausible reason.
It is next submitted that there is allegation that the Kongress Prasad Yadav vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr. ... ...

1 petitioner did so with an intention to cheat the complainant.
It is next submitted that keeping in view that huge amount of money has been dishonestly misappropriated by the petitioner, there is every chance of the petitioner absconding, if released on bail.
It is therefore submitted that the petitioner ought not to be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Considering the serious nature of allegation against the petitioner of defrauding huge amount of money and keeping in view the chances of his absconding, if released on bail, this Court is of the considered view that this is not a fit case where the above named petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail of the above named petitioner is rejected.
